execution: At least one day after feature availability, at next-next bar open; reward only after close of eighth later bar
learner: Actual BEAN SpongeDQN replay/Adam/Huber, gamma=0 contextual strategy-value regression
teaching: All actions, cash/half/full initial exposure, all mature positive and negative outcomes within train cutoff; no cherry-picked winners
pattern_transfer: Fixed 75% neural value plus 25% mean reward of 32 nearest mature training patterns on other symbols when at least 16 exist and mean squared normalized distance<=1; else neural values. Expected reward reserve .10 percent log return; otherwise prefer hold/cash. No fitted future scaler.
selection: Maximize worst of two forward development fold mean net returns; tie mean, lower budget, seed; freeze before development audit
promotion_rule: Both fold returns positive, development audit positive, beats cash/buy-hold/SMA/Donchian/untrained/pattern-only on audit, worst asset daily-close drawdown<=25%; even a pass is development evidence only
future_promotion: Require a separately registered new forward or independent dataset evaluation; opened final year cannot count again
narratives: No point-in-time historical news provided; current headlines excluded
